IDQ20829
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Moderate Flood Warning for the Lower Condamine River

Issued at 12:30 pm AEST on Tuesday 3 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 8


MODERATE FLOODING EASING AT CHINCHILLA WEIR
MINOR FLOOD PEAK POSSIBLE AT CONDAMINE DURING WEDNESDAY EVENING

Rainfall during last week across the Upper Condamine River catchment has caused river
level rises and minor to major flooding along the Condamine River. The flood peak is now
passing Chinchilla Weir. Further downstream at Condamine a minor flood peak is possible
during Wednesday evening.

Condamine River downstream of Oakey Creek to Cotswold:
Moderate flooding is occurring along the Condamine River downstream of Oakey Creek to
Cotswold.

The Condamine River at Chinchilla Weir TW peaked at 8.49 m around 09:45 pm Monday, with
moderate flooding. The river is currently at 8.21 m and falling, with moderate flooding.
The Condamine River at Chinchilla Weir TW is likely to fall below the moderate flood level
(8.00 m) Tuesday afternoon. The river is likely to remain above the minor flood level
(6.00 m) during Thursday 05 November.

The Condamine River at Condamine is currently at 5.50 m and rising, above the minor flood
level (5.00 m). The Condamine River at Condamine may peak near 6.70 m Wednesday evening,
with minor flooding.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 01:00 PM AEST on Wednesday 04 November 2026.
